name: Smoky Beef Chili with Black Beans, Pepper, Carrot, Cilantro & Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
6 medium carrots
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Peel, halve, and mince onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground beef
2 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
When the beef is done, add veggies and tomato paste to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

Add beans and broth to the pot; stir to combine the chili, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the chili is done, add half of the cilantro and stir to combine. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
To serve, divide chili between bowls; top with reserved cilantro and a dollop of yogurt. Enjoy!
